source_documents.title: Insight into the strong aggregation-induced emission of low-conjugated racemic C6-unsubstituted tetrahydropyrimidines through crystal-structure-property relationship of polymorphs

reference_evidence_units.quote: THPs 1–3 in different organic solvents (cyclohexane, ethanol and acetonitrile etc.) are practically non-emissive
reference_evidence_units.subject: THPs 1-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solutions in the named solvents compared with crystalline polymorphs.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The series is nearly nonemissive in solution but emissive in crystals.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Qualitative solution comparison; do not infer measured solution rate constants from negligible emission.

reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 2c and 2c-prime; Table 1, integrating-sphere yields at 380 nm and lifetimes at 360 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Emission peaks 469/484 nm, yields 48/28%, lifetimes 11/6.8 ns; derived kr 0.44/0.41 and knr 0.47/1.06 in units of 10^8 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Full table columns were read with their headers, not as an unassigned numerical sequence. Rates are derived from yield/lifetime, not direct transition measurements.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all polymorphs with longer lem values, 1c, 2c0, 3b and 3c, show an unpaired packing mode
reference_evidence_units.subject: THPs 1-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal structures, paired RS versus unpaired RR/SS packing.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Packing arrangements differ between polymorphs without changing molecular connectivity.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A correlation with emission is not unique proof of one excited-state process. The extracted prime is represented as 0.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of intramolecular motion (RIM) by intra- and inter- molecular interactions
reference_evidence_units.subject: THPs 1-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source explanation of the solution-to-aggregate change.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign reduced nonradiative loss to motion restriction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Retain as an interpretation supported by crystal/rate comparisons, not a directly measured molecular trajectory.

reference_evidence_units.quote: both a local excitation state (LE) and an intramolecular charge transfer excitation state (ICT) exist
reference_evidence_units.subject: THP 1 polymorphs; analogous orbitals reported for THPs 2 and 3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HOMO/LUMO calculations based on crystal conformations; main Figure 6 is 1b/1c, other polymorphs cited in Figure S5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors interpret the orbital distributions as LE/ICT contributions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: For THPs 2 and 3, the analogous orbital figures are reported in missing SI; they are not independently inspected here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: improved electronic coupling via through-bond and through-space pathways
reference_evidence_units.subject: THPs 1-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Computed orbitals combined with Table 1 rates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors associate increased radiative rates with electronic coupling and favorable LE/ICT processes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No measured solution kr is available in the selected evidence; the enhancement relative to solution is interpreted.

reference_evidence_units.quote: they can form emissive poly- morphs by through-bond and through-space electron coupling in aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: THPs 1-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source conclusion integrating polymorph structures, spectra and calculations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Intermolecular packing and electronic coupling are central to the authors' aggregate-emission account.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Generic coupling is not by itself a resolved H/J exciton, excimer or exciplex; preserve that taxonomy boundary.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Motion restriction is the source's central nonradiative explanation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper explicitly compares packing arrangements and their optical consequences for identical molecular connectivity.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: LE/ICT mixing contributes to the electronic account, with target-specific and series-level calculations distinguished.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source quantitatively separates radiative and nonradiative rates; this overlaps the RIM/packing explanation rather than being an independent cause.
